01 / The challenge

What the job asks of your van.

Charity and community vehicles carry your cause around the county. Minibuses, collection vans and outreach vehicles can raise awareness, credit sponsors and recruit volunteers every time they are on the road. Whether you need charity van signwriting, sponsor panel vehicle livery or not-for-profit fleet branding, the layout has to work on your vehicle as it really is.

01

Tight budgets

Every pound counts. Graphics need to be cost-effective and last.

02

Sponsor credits

Funders and sponsors often need to be credited.

03

Several messages

Donate, volunteer and get help may all compete for space.

02 / What to include

What your van must say.

  • Charity name and logo
  • What you do, in one line
  • Registered charity number
  • Website for donating or volunteering

Not sure what to include? Our guide to what to put on a work van walks you through it.

06 / Design tips

Build the layout around the job.

01

Pick one main ask

Donate, volunteer or get support — lead with the one that matters most.

02

Plan sponsor space

Give sponsors a consistent, tidy panel rather than scattering logos.

03

Show your charity number

It reassures people that you are a registered charity.

Charity vehicle graphics.

Looking for charity vehicle graphics? We design, print and fit community minibus graphics and charity van signwriting at our Norwich workshop for businesses across Norfolk. Every charity vehicle graphics project starts with a free design visual and a written, fitted price.

Community minibus graphics

Designed around your exact vehicle, with your name, services and contact details laid out to read clearly from the road.

Before you book

Charity vehicle graphics: your questions.

Can you include sponsor logos?

Yes. We will design a tidy sponsor panel that can be updated later.

Do you brand minibuses?

Yes. Send the make, model and photos so we can plan around windows.

Can graphics be updated when sponsors change?

Yes. Sponsor panels can be designed as separate elements that are easy to replace.
